mentions.name: Seaquel
mentions.description: Seaquel is an open source database client that works offline and doesn't track user activity. It includes a visual query builder and a separate SQL tutorial.
mentions.problem: The author wished for a database client that is open source, works offline, and doesn't track what you do.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I build Seaquel, the database client I've always wished I had. It's open source, works offline and doesn't track what you do.

It has a visual query builder and separate SQL tutorial.
